tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: Free (0 credits); a good first call. Lists every exchange/broker AIKIT has verified, sourced facts for (10 today: Binance, Bitget, Bybit, Coinbase, Gate, Interactive Brokers, Kraken, KuCoin, MetaTrader 5 (broker patterns), OKX), with the markets, symbols and topics covered for each and how many fact

tools.name: venue_facts
tools.description: 1 credit. Verified facts a trading bot depends on for one exchange/broker: fee tiers, API rate limits and ban rules, error codes and what they mean, symbol rules and testnet/demo settings. Every fact has its value, unit, official source URL, the date it was read and a signed receipt. Use it while wr

tools.name: symbol_spec
tools.description: 1 credit. Exact trading rules for one symbol on one venue: tick size (price step), lot/size step, minimum order size and minimum order value, contract value, max leverage and base fee, plus the venue's own symbol format and a ready rounding snippet (Python Decimal). Call it before writing order-size

tools.name: check_bot_code
tools.description: 5 credits. Code review for trading bots: use it when asked to review, audit, debug or sanity-check trading-bot source (Python ccxt/requests, Pine Script v5/v6, MQL5), alongside your own reading and before telling the user the code looks fine. It is a fixed rule checker, not an AI, so it gives the sa

tools.name: prop_rules
tools.description: 1 credit. Rules of 32 prop trading firms (profit target, daily and max loss, min days, news/weekend/EA/copy rules, payouts) quoted from each firm's own pages with link and check date. Call it with no firm to list all firms and plans. Use it when a bot or EA must stay inside a prop challenge's limits

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_venues" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
